provenance_summary.original_execution_outputs: The raw original model outputs, generated sequence set, structures, logs, and complete input/configuration snapshots are not retained in this repository package.
provenance_summary.historical_source_artifacts: Historical source references and hashes are preserved in audit.json and the two historical SHA-256 manifests. Those manifests describe the prior package and are not inventories of files currently committed here.
provenance_summary.later_measurement_and_aggregation: The retained CSV/JSON tables, comparison text, and figures are historical derived artifacts assembled from prior generation, prediction, measurement, and comparison records. Their per-file classification is in provenance.json. No measurement, model inference, or plot generation was performed during the current repository migration.
provenance_summary.repository_repackaging: run.json, configuration.json, input/manifest.json, result.json, provenance.json, audit.json, REPORT.md, and surrounding indexes were created or updated to establish repository-relative identity and provenance. Their edits do not constitute a scientific rerun.

artifact_naming.reason: Verified artifact IDs, original execution timestamps, canonical run references, model identifiers, and output-generating parameters are unavailable, so convention-compliant generated filenames cannot be constructed without fabrication.

scope: Retained three-sequence reporting panel; not an inventory of all historical experiment branches.
